title: Unraveling the role of histone acetylation in sepsis biomarker discovery
summary: Histone-acetylation transcriptomic analysis using LASSO, SVM-RFE and Boruta nominated three sepsis biomarkers; follow-up patient-blood/qPCR, MR and THP-1 knockdown assays support SFT2D1’s relation to inflammatory cytokines. This is a bounded biomarker/mechanistic result, not clinical benefit. This record is limited to the study result and does not establish independent replication or real-world benefit.
organization: The First Affiliated Hospital of Bengbu Medical University
